items.title: Storm Boelo clean-up highlights business interruption insurance gaps
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, businesses face costly disruption following Storm Boelo as power cuts and flooding put commercial insurance policies under scrutiny during the peak autumn claims season.

items.title: Brokers Flag Fast Fleet Policy Adjustments as Business Critical
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, new research commissioned by specialist DCL shows that more than 80% of brokers view rapid and accurate mid-term adjustments for commercial motor fleets as essential for client service.

items.title: Cross-Market Data Sharing Exposes Multi-Insurer Funeral Fraud Scheme
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, a South African fraud scheme involving a single fabricated death across four insurers highlights the critical need for market-wide data sharing to uncover hidden risks.

items.title: Financial Ombudsman Service Turns to Phone Calls as AI Complaints Create Backlog
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, the Financial Ombudsman Service is increasing telephone contact with consumers as the use of artificial intelligence tools adds length, errors, and delays to dispute caseloads.

items.title: Public Voices Concerns and Hopes Ahead of Chancellor's Budget
items.summary: According to BBC, as Chancellor John Healey prepares to unveil his first Budget amid historic government borrowing costs, people across a range of incomes share their financial pressures and what they want from the government.
